rv.q: Stephen Unwin directs a traditional, high-spirited production that shimmers with mischievous humour
Everything drifts by pleasantly enough, but without urgency, without heat.
Following the Bath run, the production tours to Guildford, Birmingham, Sheffield, Malvern, Oxford, and Poole, and will no doubt leave a trail of good feeling in its wake.

cn.t: This Austen adaptation receives a polite but tepid reception, with critics finding it a fitting but unremarkable staging that delights devoted fans more than it innovates for the stage.
